pages.title: Chain Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bow, Crossbow$(br2)§lEffect: §r After hitting an entity, the arrow bounces to the nearest enemy within 10 blocks: 1 bounce at level I, 2 at II, 3 at III, each dealing 80% of the arrow's base damage. Conflicts with Explosive Arrow.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
